description: Public gauges and trigger feeds read live from their publishers and refreshed every three hours, independent of any analysis: river levels on the Rhine, Danube, Elbe and Mississippi, flow on the Rhône, the official Mississippi stage forecast, orange and red disaster alerts (GDACS) and US sanctions and export-control documents (Federal Register). Without a key each point answers with its latest daily value and its change over seven days; a member key adds thirty daily values and the forecast. Optional filter: group (Rhine, Danube, Elbe, Mississippi, Rhône). Each point names its publisher and licence under sources; a point whose source did not answer carries an error and no value.
